note: Product defaults (spec §8). Weights are tunable, not scientific constants.
candidate_region_rule: every catalogue region of these layers that has a prepared series for at least one selected variable; basin4 sub-basins and hex cells are reachable by user selection but are not searched automatically (hex has no series)
window_alignment: calendar years: Jan of start year to Dec of end year, anchored on the last complete common year and stepped backwards
missing_component_rule: a missing component scores 0 and is listed in missing_components; weights are not renormalised

effect.definition: abs(slope_per_decade) / sd of the fixed-baseline anomalies in the baseline period, squashed with x/(1+x)

relevance.aggregation: role-weighted share of the selected variables that are analysable for the candidate

quality.definition: mean over variables of coverage inside the window times (1 if inference applicable else 0.5), reduced by 0.2 for a fallback product or a registered caveat

stability.definition: share of analysable variables whose first-half and second-half descriptive slopes have the same sign as the full-window slope

aggregation: fixed weighted mean across variables, so more variables do not raise the score by count
